transport: Ethernet or WiFi · Modbus TCP on port 502 and a local MQTT broker on 8883 (SSL) / 1883 (plain), both stated by the Nucleo GX's own manual — but no source ties the model to the register map. Ports: 2× VE.Direct (always isolated, max 25 VE.Direct devices), VE.Can 1 isolated, VE.Can 2 non-isolated, Ethernet, WiFi, Bluetooth Smart, 3× USB-A, microSD. NO VE.Bus port and no I/O.
